/**
 * The `mcp.json` boundary for the Pi MCP bridge — schema, decode, `${VAR}`
 * expansion.
 *
 * Sibling of `mcp-extension.ts`, materialized next to it at spawn time (see
 * `setUpMcpExtension` in mcp-setup.ts) so pi's jiti loader can resolve this
 * relative import from the on-disk extension file. Like its parent it is
 * embedded byte-for-byte as the `mcp-config.ts.txt` twin, so it must stay
 * self-contained — no sibling-module imports beyond node built-ins and typebox
 * (whose root pi virtualizes).
 *
 * External config is decoded ONCE here and the rest of the bridge projects from
 * these typed variants; no ad hoc isRecord/stringOrUndefined soup leaks out.
 */

import type { Static } from "typebox";

import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";

import { Type } from "typebox";

const DEFAULT_CONFIG_FILENAME = "mcp.json";

const StdioServerSchema = Type.Object({
  type: Type.Literal("stdio"),
  command: Type.String(),
  args: Type.Optional(Type.Array(Type.String())),
  env: Type.Optional(Type.Record(Type.String(), Type.String())),
});
const HttpServerSchema = Type.Object({
  type: Type.Literal("http"),
  url: Type.String(),
  headers: Type.Optional(Type.Record(Type.String(), Type.String())),
});
const ServerSchema = Type.Union([StdioServerSchema, HttpServerSchema]);
const McpConfigSchema = Type.Object({
  mcpServers: Type.Record(Type.String(), ServerSchema),
});
type McpServer = Static<typeof ServerSchema>;
type McpConfig = Static<typeof McpConfigSchema>;

// A hand guard (not `typebox/value`, a subpath pi may not virtualize).
const isPlainRecord = (value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> =>
  typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);

// Hand-validate the decoded `mcp.json` (see `isPlainRecord`): only the fields
// the bridge reads are checked, and a malformed entry is dropped rather than
// failing the whole file. `URL.canParse` mirrors makeTransport's unguarded
// `new URL(url)` — a schemeless url is dropped here instead of throwing in
// `register`'s map and aborting sibling servers.
const isServer = (value: unknown): value is McpServer =>
  isPlainRecord(value) &&
  (value.type === "stdio"
    ? typeof value.command === "string"
    : value.type === "http" &&
      typeof value.url === "string" &&
      URL.canParse(value.url));

// Runs inside the spawned `pi` process, which pi may launch under Node (a
// compiled binary with no `bun` on PATH, or `ORI_PI_RUNTIME=node`), so read the
// environment through `globalThis.process.env` rather than the Bun-only global.
const processEnv: Readonly<Record<string, string | undefined>> =
  globalThis.process.env;

const readMcpConfig = async (): Promise<McpConfig | undefined> => {
  const path = processEnv.ORI_MCP_CONFIG ?? DEFAULT_CONFIG_FILENAME;
  let parsed: unknown;
  try {
    parsed = JSON.parse(await readFile(path, "utf-8"));
  } catch {
    // Absent/unreadable/malformed mcp.json → register nothing, no throw.
    return undefined;
  }
  if (!isPlainRecord(parsed) || !isPlainRecord(parsed.mcpServers)) {
    return undefined;
  }
  const servers: Record<string, McpServer> = {};
  for (const [name, server] of Object.entries(parsed.mcpServers)) {
    if (isServer(server)) {
      servers[name] = server;
    } else {
      // Say which server vanished. A connect failure is logged in the bridge's
      // catch, so without this a config typo (a schemeless url, a missing
      // command) would be the one failure mode with no breadcrumb at all.
      console.warn(`mcp server ${name} skipped: invalid config`);
    }
  }
  return { mcpServers: servers };
};

const ENV_REFERENCE_PATTERN = /\$\{([^}]+)\}/gu;

const expandEnv = (value: string): string =>
  value.replaceAll(
    ENV_REFERENCE_PATTERN,
    (_match: string, name: string) => processEnv[name] ?? ""
  );

const expandEnvRecord = (
  record: Record<string, string>
): Record<string, string> =>
  Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(record).map(([key, value]) => [key, expandEnv(value)])
  );

export { expandEnvRecord, isPlainRecord, readMcpConfig };
export type { McpConfig, McpServer };
